#  13037 - Linear and Weakly Non-Linear Differential Equations in Physics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13037 - module is no longer offered from SS 2025**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Linear and Weakly Non-Linear Differential Equations in Physics**  |  
|  Lineare und schwach nichtlineare Differentialgleichungen in der Physik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Bestehorn, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successfully completing the module, students have a profound knowledge of using and solving of ordinary and partial differential equations in physics. They are able to formulate model equations and solving them independently. Additionally the module supported synergetic connections to other fields (interdisciplinarity).  |  
| Contents:  | Differential equations in mechanics, hydrodynamics, and nonequilibrium chemistry. Linear and nonlinear diffusion equation, complex Ginzburg-Landau equation, Swift-Hohenberg equation. Methods: linear stability analysis, normal forms, Turing and Hopf instabilities  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Knowledge of theoretical physics (level Bachelor studies)
  * Firm knowledge in analysis and linear algebra

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Guckenheimer, Holmes: Nonlinear oscillations, dynamical systems, and bifurcations of vector fields
  * H. Haken: Synergetik
  * J. Argyris: Die Erforschung des Chaos
  * M. Bestehorn: Hydrodynamik und Strukturbildung

Further references will be provided during the lecture.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  **Prerequisite:**
  * Successful completion of exercise assignments (75% must be reached)

**Final module examination:**
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Physical Specialization with theoretical focus“, topic area „Theory, Simulation and further topics“
  * Study programme Applied Mathematics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Applications“, field „Physics“

Self organised studies: 
  * re-work of the lecture
  * treatment of homework
  * literature work

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Linear and Weakly Non-Linear Differential Equations in Physics (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Accompanying exercises (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 14.01.2025 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
